title: Radix pass postconditions
statement: Let $\mu:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{Z}$ be memory before the pass, $\mu':\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{Z}$ memory after it, $A$ be radix-pass arguments, $\pi$ a list of indices, and $kd:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ their keys. The memories agree outside the region of $A.R$ cells starting at $A.\mathrm{perm}$; for every $t\le A.\mathrm{nb}$, the counter cell $A.\mathrm{cnt}+t$ contains the number of entries in the key sequence of $\pi$ that are less than $t$. In addition, there is a list $\pi'$ that is a stable ordering of $\pi$ by $kd$ and whose entries are stored consecutively in memory starting at $A.\mathrm{perm}$.
caveat: The referenced predicates SameOutside, cntLt, keyAt, IsStablePass, and SegN are not defined in the supplied snippet, so their exact conventions are not recoverable here.
